sources.title: GitHub - zhenlan0426/Bengali-ASR
sources.snippet: Bengali-ASR provides scripts and notebooks for building an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system for the Bengali language. The project uses the Whisper architecture with JAX/TPU as well as PyTorch implementations based on Wav2Vec2.
